output_list.criticism: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. After 'require(tokenBalances[msg.sender]>=_value);', the 'tokenBalances[msg.sender]' is checked to not be zero, and then it is subtracted from it. If '_value' is at maximum uint256, the result of this operation will be zero, bypassing the require statement. This vulnerability allows attackers to prevent the owner from transferring tokens to other users.
